69:t_1:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[In old society, the name for a social unit formed on the basis of blood ties between spouses of the male and female sexes.]

69:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
[So there was such a custom...]

69:t_1:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The civilization and cultural style of this $$ガルガンティア船団$$ are alien even compared with those of $c.]

69:t_1:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[However, the principles by which society is organized are shared, and from their point of view, the $$人類銀河同盟$$ is judged to be the anomaly.]

69:t_1:13.en:
$n
「What's wrong, $$レド$$? Is something troubling you?」

69:t_1:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Get it together, will you? I'm planning to leave things to you after I'm gone.」

69:t_1:15.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ガロード$$... are you go-ing a-way?」

69:t_1:16.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah. Once the repairs on the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ are done, I'm planning to go along with $c too.」

69:t_1:17.en:
$$ガロード$$
「With just the $$ダブルエックス$$ and the $$Ｇファルコン$$, a long trip with $$ティファ$$ was out of the question, but if we have a battleship, no problem.」

69:t_1:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Significant proposal. I recommend that you tell them about the stress Ensign $$レド$$ is feeling and get their advice on how to break through it.」

69:t_1:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「So this pilot support and enlightenment interface seems to be a kind partner.」

69:t_1:23.en:
$n
「Why don't you have $$アル$$ set up for constant communication with you too?」

69:t_1:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, thanks. In his case, far from enlightening me, all he gives me is stress.」

69:t_1:25.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...I think Chamber is right. If something is troubling you, let us hear it.」

69:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Her brother... You mean $$ベベル$$?」

69:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
「I hea-rd that he... i-s ill...」

69:t_1:29.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't know the details either, but I hear his chest is bad and he can't get out much.」

69:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
「In the $$人類銀河同盟$$... people who can-not fight are dis-posed of...」

69:t_1:35.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And you were fine with that?」

69:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「...$$エイミー$$ a-sked me the same thing to-o.」

69:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「I did no-t... un-derstand the meaning of the ques-tion...」

69:t_1:40.en:
$$ティファ$$
「But you felt something... You are anxious because you cannot explain what it is.」

69:t_1:42.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is so frustrating! People have things to do besides fighting! That's why...」

69:t_1:43.en:
$$オルダム$$
「That is enough, $$ガロード$$.」

69:t_1:45.en:
$$オルダム$$
「He has come from a distant star. There may well be parts of how he thinks that differ from ours at the root.」

69:t_1:47.en:
$$ティファ$$
「It's Dr. $$オルダム$$. He is a doctor.」

69:t_1:48.en:
$$レド$$
「He ca-me up in my talk with $$ベベル$$ to-o... A-s the one who knows the most in this fleet...」

69:t_1:49.en:
$$オルダム$$
「So we finally meet, $$レド$$. Thank you for protecting the fleet the other day.」

69:t_1:50.en:
$$レド$$
「I ha-ve something to ask... $$チェインバー#robot$$, interpret.」

69:t_1:52.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Oh... So that is the voice of the machine that understands language that I have heard about.」

69:t_1:53.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request your interpretation of this fleet's organization.」

69:t_1:54.en:
$$オルダム$$
「What do you mean by interpretation?」

69:t_1:55.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...This fleet is inefficient. The chain of command and control are incomplete, and the residents' behavior is disordered. The significance of protecting the weak is also unclear.」

69:t_1:56.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Ha ha, I see. So that is how it looks to a visitor from space.」

69:t_1:57.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Ah, pardon me. The efficiency you speak of covers a rather narrow range.」

69:t_1:59.en:
$$オルダム$$
「I believe this question of yours started with $$ベベル$$, so you might try talking with him a little more.」

69:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Can any useful information be obtained through dialogue with him?」

69:t_1:61.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Whether it is useful is for you to judge.」

69:t_1:67.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...You met Dr. $$オルダム$$, didn't you.」

69:t_1:69.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is unable to comprehend organizational behavior in $$ガルガンティア$$.」

69:t_1:71.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I inquire as to the reason for this inefficient and futile management.」

69:t_1:72.en:
$$ベベル$$
「The fleet isn't an organization. We're all just sticking together.」

69:t_1:73.en:
$$ベベル$$
「We sometimes fight, we sometimes help each other, and that's just how we live.」

69:t_1:74.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I inquire as to the meaning of that.」

69:t_1:75.en:
$$ベベル$$
「As long as everyone can live in peace, isn't that good enough?」

69:t_1:76.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...In the $$人類銀河同盟$$, a person such as yourself would be culled at once.」

69:t_1:77.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Because someone like me wouldn't be any use in the fight against the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, I suppose...」

69:t_1:78.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But if that's so, then what happens to the $$銀河同盟$$ once you defeat all the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$? What will $$レド$$ do?」

69:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「I will stan-d by un-til the next order.」

69:t_1:80.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Then what if the next order never comes?」

69:t_1:81.en:
$$レド$$
「I will con-tinue to stand by.」

69:t_1:82.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Then you're the same as us.」

69:t_1:84.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Because standing by... means you keep living, doesn't it?」

uncertain: Ledo's lightly accented speech rendered as plain English (as dlg_2009_02 did for the same stage of his accent), not hyphen-split.
69:t_1:16/17: ダナン and クォーター shortened forms rendered with full tokens $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ / $$マクロス・クォーター$$, Ｇファルコン with $$Ｇファルコン$$; $c kept.
先生 for Oldham rendered 'Dr.' (69:t_1:44,47,67); Tiffa 47 'It's Dr. Oldham. He is a doctor.'
銀河同盟 (Bebel, 78) = 'the Galactic Alliance' (not the full token); 人類銀河同盟 uses its token.
Row 8 Chamber definition of family and row 22 パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス ('pilot support and enlightenment interface') are my own wordings.
69:t_1:21 Chamber's 有意提言 = 'Significant proposal.' to match 懐疑提言 = 'Skeptical proposal' in dlg_2008.
Row 13/23/33 speaker $n (protagonist) per brief, translated as Hibiki's lines.
